statement: Unify READY-lease renewal cadence ownership in NodeReadyLeaseAuthority (DEFAULT_RENEWAL_INTERVAL_MS = 5000 ms for a 15000 ms lease) so HeartbeatService write coalescing renews READY leases at 1/3 TTL instead of suppressing the +5000 ms tick until +10000 ms, and eliminate Number(null) -> 0 timestamp coercion across NodeReadyLeaseAuthority, LeaseService, node-readiness-policy.js, and message-group-target-resolver.js so null ready_lease_expires_at is never treated as epoch-0 expired or finite.

constraints.statement: NodeReadyLeaseAuthority (src/control-plane/node-ready-lease-authority.js) is the single canonical owner of the READY-lease renewal cadence (DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 15000, DEFAULT_RENEWAL_CADENCE_DIVISOR = 3, DEFAULT_RENEWAL_INTERVAL_MS = 5000, resolveRenewalIntervalMs(ttlMs), and instance renewalIntervalMs). HEARTBEAT_DEFAULT.INTERVAL_MS, HEARTBEAT_DEFAULT.NODE_METADATA_MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS, and HEARTBEAT_DEFAULT.NODE_METADATA_MAX_STALENESS_MS derive from DEFAULT_RENEWAL_INTERVAL_MS (5000 ms), and NodeLifecyclePublication and HeartbeatService lifecycle methods consume the shared cadence contract rather than magic divisor 3 or 10000 ms constants.

Null, undefined, empty-string, boolean, or non-positive timestamps must never coerce to epoch 0 via Number(null) -> 0: (1) NodeReadyLeaseAuthority.parseLeaseExpiresAt returns null for absent/null/non-positive values, isExpired({ ready_lease_expires_at: null }, now) returns false, and holdsLiveLease({ ready_lease_expires_at: null }, now) returns false; (2) LeaseService.sweepExpiredLeases does not sweep JOINING nodes with ready_lease_expires_at: null and noteLeaseSkipObservation records leaseExpiredForMs: null instead of now - 0 (~1.79e12 ms); (3) node-readiness-policy.js getFiniteNumber returns null for null/undefined/empty/boolean, getNodeReadyLeaseExpiresAt({ ready_lease_expires_at: null }) returns null, and isNodeReadyLeaseExplicitlyCleared({ status: 'STOPPING', ready_lease_expires_at: null }) returns true; (4) isReadyNodeRow in message-group-target-resolver.js rejects ready_lease_expires_at: null.

Dedicated unit test test/control-plane/node-ready-lease-renewal-cadence.test.js witnesses all five obligations (a)-(e) red on unpatched source before sealing and green after the repair with zero regressions across control-plane, node, bootstrap, and message-group suites.
